scope: One graph-level theorem: an unordered pair has at most one common-neighbor owner under the explicit no-four-cycle hypothesis and four-vertex distinctness premises. Three conditional integer-count theorems prove the packing threshold and exclude positive excess below it. Finite cardinal pair summation, representative reduction, projective-plane instantiation and full parameter equalities retain written proofs; they are not claimed fully formalized.
